name: Layout Image
summary: Text to image with MOSS-Image (Apache-2.0); also takes a layout JSON that places each text and object in its own box.

source.notes: MOSS-Image SFT, int8. Its Qwen3.5-9B text encoder also rewrites a short prompt into a caption. A layout prompt is the JSON MOSSImageLayoutPrompt writes: {"summary": {"caption": ...}, "items": [{"label": "text"|"object"|"character", "caption": ..., "text": ..., "bbox": [y0, x0, y1, x1]}], "bbox_coord_space": "abs_centralized", "bbox_format": "yxyx"} (pixels, origin at the centre); turn the rewrite off for it. Cloud9 validation: native INT8 diffusion and W4A8 Qwen3.5-9B, direct prompt, 1024x1024, 25 er_sde steps; complete Freefield CLI render in 1112.4 seconds without a memory-guard trip. Optional prompt rewriting and larger sizes were not qualified by that test.

inputs.label: Prompt or layout JSON
inputs.default: A minimalist concert poster: the title "MIDNIGHT TACOS" in huge bold letters at the top, "LIVE · FRIDAY 9 PM" below it, a neon taco truck at night, risograph print, hot pink and teal

inputs.label: Rewrite my prompt
inputs.help: Optional caption expansion adds CPU preparation time on Cloud9. Direct prompting is the validated default; keep rewrite off for a layout JSON.

test.prompt: A documentary photograph of a red bicycle leaning against a clean white stucco wall, soft daylight, side view, natural shadows, fine details of spokes and paint.
